title: Door Duty
summary: Judy's door man got hurt, so she asks V to stand Lizzie's door with her for one night.
description: Judy's door man was stabbed, so Susie Q put her on the door of Lizzie's Bar for the night. Judy asks V to stand the door with her for an hour.

start.bringUp: Judy's door man got stabbed and Susie Q put her on the door tonight. Bring up, in your own way, that you want V to stand the door with you for an hour, and that V is scarier than you are.

door.name: the front door of Lizzie's Bar

J2.ask.01.text: Our door guy got stabbed. He's fine. Susie wants me on the door tonight. Me.

J2.ask.02.text: You're scarier than me and I'm meaner than you. Stand with me for an hour?

J2.shift.01.text: Rules. No Claws, no creeps, no corpo who thinks he's funny.

J2.shift.02.text: Here we go. Your turn, tough guy.

J2.shift.03.text: Gone. You didn't even yell. Weird.

J2.shift.04.text: Okay, that's one way. Shake it off.

J2.shift.05.text: That one's taking pictures. Claw. I can smell the cologne.

J2.shift.06.text: Wait. I know her. She's from the Clouds.

J2.shift.07.text: Come on, sweetie. Inside. Nobody's touching you here.

J2.shift.08.text: You sent her away. We need to talk about that. Not now.

J2.close.01.text: Shift's over. I'm buying. Don't argue, it's free for me.

g1.asks: Why do you think she came here? Of all places.
g1.know: The three incidents at the door and how each ended, and the doll's state. Susie Q put you on the door, and you are not sure you are any good at it.
g1.secret: She wonders whether she is any good at being Mox, or just angry.
g1.wants: V's honest view of the Mox.

stages.label: Judy is waiting at Lizzie's front door
stages.objective: Meet Judy at the front door of Lizzie's Bar
stages.know: Your door man got stabbed and Susie Q put you on the door tonight. You hate needing help, and you will not say so.
stages.wants: V to stand the door with you for an hour.

stages.label: A drunk corpo tests the door
stages.objective: Turn away the drunk corpo at Lizzie's door with Judy
stages.know: You and V are on Lizzie's door. A drunk corpo is weaving up the street and wants in, and the rules are no corpo who thinks he's funny.
stages.wants: V to deal with the drunk.

stages.label: A Tyger Claw scout photographs the bar
stages.objective: Deal with the Tyger Claw scout outside Lizzie's with Judy
stages.know: A Tyger Claw scout is taking pictures of Lizzie's from across the street. He is not here to drink.
stages.wants: V to get the scout to leave, one way or another.

stages.label: A scared girl from the Clouds asks for Judy
stages.objective: Talk to the scared girl from the Clouds at Lizzie's door with Judy
stages.know: A young doll from the Clouds is standing at the door asking for Judy by name. She is not a fighter and she is not a threat.
stages.wants: V and Judy to decide whether she comes in.

stages.label: Judy buys V a drink after the shift
stages.objective: Have a drink with Judy inside Lizzie's Bar
stages.know: The shift is over and you are inside Lizzie's. You are buying V a drink, and you will say it is free for you.
stages.wants: V to stay and talk with you for a while.

quiet-door.memory: You and Judy worked Lizzie's door for a night, and the girl from the Clouds walked in safe.

rough-night.memory: You and Judy held Lizzie's door through a brawl, and she tells the story with more blood every time.

doll-turned-away.memory: You sent the girl from the Clouds away from Lizzie's door, and Judy is still short with you about it.

left-early.memory: You left Lizzie's door before the shift was over, and Judy finished it alone.
